Episode 398 (presumed; title omits "| Ep N") opens by satirizing yesterday's Candyland illegal-nanny mansion comments (two nannies per child, elite Jewish agency, "we only hoard illegals") then pivots to Jennica Pounds (data republican): hired as a Department of War special government employee around the Tyler Robinson preliminary-hearing week, she posted a long X thread attacking Candace and defending the official 30-06 / NCRI / Erika-dehumanization narrative without disclosing DoD employment; she has now resigned, and the host mocks "where were you on 9/10."

The core beat is a paid anti-Candace clipping economy. Tips and an Atlantic investigation by Ali Breland describe Monster Lab / Clippet (DBA) and Elephant Clipping, run from Latvia by Matt Servius over Discord, paying editors by impressions (e.g. $120k August TPUSA generic pool at $300/1M views; $75k one-week Andrew Wilson debate pivot with instructions that Candace may appear only if she looks bad). Campaign Google Drives for Erika Kirk clips were uploaded beginning September 15, 2025 (five days after Charlie's assassination) by Enclave and Key staff (Jules Katz, Benjamin Goodman, Jack O'Hara); Enclave CEO Blake Wynn (Steve Wynn's nephew) is framed as Erika's close friend who appears beside her at medal, gala, and DoD emotional-asset moments. Andrew Kolvet denies TPUSA works with a Latvian company; the host calls that the audacity of the gaslight. Wayback Machine captures of Monster Lab from September 12, 2025 forward show only "loading," which the host treats as a wipe hiding the go-live date (possibly first Erika campaign). Blake's Fargo Talks "rare bucket" praise of Erika is played; a Las Vegas / Howard Hughes / Adelson / Wynn / Kash Patel syndicate thread is restated. Andrew Tate's Hustlers University is credited (via an Edson interview clip) as the clipping-economy pioneer. Closing comments revisit the unnamed fire-captain CPR dog-that-is-not-barking, ask who sponsors the Latvian operator, push moretips@candace.com tip intake, mock shifting smear packages, advise starving paid clippers of impressions, note sponsor-threat campaigns, and plug Conspiracy Girly merch.
